=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
note key: plain letter a..z maps to the letter at the same place here
text key "phqgiumeaylnofdxjkrcvstzwb"
text msg "the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog, 42 times"
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note enc maps each lower-case letter through key; other bytes are copied
fn enc a view uchar * r edit uchar * to void
for i ulong len a
c = get a i
if and ge c 97 le c 122
c = get key sub c 97
end
put r i c
end
end
note dec builds the inverse table first, then maps through it
fn dec a view uchar * r edit uchar * to void
inv = new uchar 26 0
for j ulong 26
put inv sub get key j 97 add uchar j 97
end
for i ulong len a
c = get a i
if and ge c 97 le c 122
c = get inv sub c 97
end
put r i c
end
end
fn main to int
n = len msg
e = new uchar 256 0
d = new uchar 256 0
emit msg
emit nl
enc msg part e 0 n
emit part e 0 n
emit nl
dec part e 0 n part d 0 n
emit part d 0 n
emit nl
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog, 42 times
cei jvaql hkdtf udz yvoxr dsik cei npbw gdm, 42 caoir
the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog, 42 times
</pre>
